Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security review / SOC 2 package)

Hi Chloe & Aaron,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the clear context on Aurelia's security requirements for the ML inference surface. Per our call, I’m attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review and SOC 2 package delivery so we can align on milestones, owners, and target dates. High-level recap below: 

- Objective: Complete security review and receive SOC 2 evidence package to enable procurement and legal review by Aurelia.
- Target close for this milestone: 2026-07-15 (to keep the broader procurement timeline intact).
- Key dependencies: SOC 2 questionnaire completed by Aurelia (we provide), evidence artifacts from Redwood (logs, config screenshots, SOC 2 report excerpts), and a short chat between your security team and Rishi for any clarifications.

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm that 2026-07-15 works as the target for SOC 2 package delivery and procurement sign-off.
2) Share preferred owner for returning the attached questionnaire (Aurelia security contact).
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical Q/A between your security team and Rishi next week — propose Thurs 6/25 or Fri 6/26.

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx, Aurelia_SOC2_questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Marissa, thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. A few quick notes from Aurelia's side:

- Target date: 2026-07-15 is tight but doable if we receive the SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence manifest this week.
- Questionnaire owner: Aaron Patel (copied) will own completing the questionnaire on our side.
- We will need the following from Redwood as part of the evidence package: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), list of controls mapped to Aurelia ask, sample config screenshots (VPC/networking, IAM roles, logging), 90 days of audit logs or a log-retention statement, and any third-party penetration test summaries.

Can you confirm you can provide an evidence_manifest.pdf listing the artifacts and expected delivery dates? Also please add a milestone in the MAP for the security Q/A and assign Rishi as the technical owner.

Appreciate it — Chloe

Chloe / Aaron,

Thanks — confirmed and added to the MAP. Per your ask, attached is an evidence_manifest.pdf that lists artifacts and proposed delivery cadence. Summary of the updated MAP milestones below (also updated in attached MAP-v1.xlsx):

1) 2026-06-24 (TODAY) — Redwood: Upload evidence_manifest.pdf (includes list of artifacts and expected delivery dates). Owner: Marissa Cole.
2) 2026-06-26 — Aurelia: Complete SOC 2 questionnaire (Aurelia_SOC2_questionnaire_v1.xlsx). Owner: Aaron Patel.
3) 2026-06-28 — Redwood: Deliver SOC 2 report extract + control mapping doc + sample config screenshots. Owner: Rishi Malhotra.
4) 2026-07-01 — Joint: Security Q/A call (30 mins) to review any clarification items. Owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) / Aaron Patel (Aurelia). Proposed times: 2026-07-01 14:00 or 2026-07-02 10:00 PT.
5) 2026-07-08 — Redwood: Provide remaining artifacts or clarifications identified during Q/A. Owner: Rishi Malhotra.
6) 2026-07-15 — Aurelia: Final procurement sign-off / legal acceptance. Owner: Chloe Summers.

Dependencies and risks:
- If the questionnaire is delayed beyond 2026-06-26, the target close may shift by 1-2 weeks.
- Any gaps in required evidence (e.g., penetration test reports) may require additional review cycles.

Attachments: evidence_manifest.pdf, MAP-v1.xlsx

Vivek / Rishi: FYI — please confirm you can meet the artifact delivery dates (Rishi, items 3 & 5). Vivek I’ll follow up about exec approval and any discount prompts if procurement pushes timeline.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOC 2 deliverables — confirmed owners & dates

Thanks for the ping — I confirm the delivery windows. Quick notes from the security delivery perspective:

- SOC 2 Type II extract: I will pull the redacted report and control mapping by 2026-06-28. Expect a PDF extract and a control-mapping spreadsheet.
- Config screenshots: I will gather sample screenshots for VPC setup, IAM role policies, logging stack (CloudWatch/ELK), and rotation/key management (KMS) by 2026-06-28.
- Logs: We can provide a log-retention statement and example log snippets. Full 90-day raw logs are sensitive; we will provide redacted excerpts and a retention/extract process description.
- Pen-test: We have a summary report (Q1 2026) — I will include the summary and a redaction-safe artifact.

I’ll block time for the proposed Q/A on 2026-07-01 14:00 PT. Marissa — if Chloe prefers the alternate slot I can move things around.

Rishi
Lead Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
